summary: Kyverna Therapeutics, a biotech firm, filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, announcing the appointment of Gregory Martini as CFO effective May 18. This is a C-suite change, not a routine filing, triggered by a board decision. The filing details Mr. Martini's compensation: $525,000 base salary, 40% annual bonus, and a $300,000 sign-on bonus paid in two tranches ($150,000 shortly after start, $150,000 on first anniversary, subject to continued employment). The filing is a standard current report under Items 5.02 and 8.01. What to watch: whether this signals a strategic shift, or if the prior CFO departure was abrupt.
